scientific_question: Does the production pair-VQ MLP family fail because gradients are evaluated on the compact forward path, or because the live local projection operator cannot track even the exact dense path?

endpoint_shadow_result.finding: The live compact endpoint is +0.1580 CE behind its matched parent. Adding the decoded terminal carry to c_fc, c_proj, or both improves fixed CE by only 0.000269, 0.000199, and 0.000259 respectively, so carry realization is not functionally causal.

offline_capacity_result.finding: A fresh terminal fit of the identical two-stage c_fc plus fast residual and one-stage c_proj plus fast residual model family reaches +0.031719 CE, inside the frozen +0.05 gate.

theory.dense_path: D_{t+1}=Muon(D_t, grad L(D_t)) is the exact matched dense-MLP parent update.
theory.nonintervening_shadow: C_{t+1}=P_live(D_{t+1}; C_t), where P_live uses the production layer-private pair codebooks, two-stage c_fc, one-stage c_proj, fast scalar residuals, local 16-neighbor code reassignment every eight steps, and centroid updates every step.
theory.causal_separation: C_t is never used for training forward, backward, clipping, momentum, or D_{t+1}. It is installed only during a second fixed-window evaluation. Thus dense-vs-shadow CE measures projection tracking on the same optimization path, whereas ordinary compact-vs-dense CE includes gradient-field drift.
theory.gradient_path_failure: If L(C_T)-L(D_T)<=0.05 while ordinary compact training remains +0.158, the representation and local tracker are sufficient on the dense path; the missing mechanism is grad L(C_t) not matching grad L(D_t), amplified by GELU and residual co-adaptation.
theory.assignment_hysteresis: If L(C_T)-L(D_T)>0.05 while a fresh terminal fit of the same family remains +0.031719, the live warm-start local projector is trapped in a worse code assignment than the globally refit endpoint.
excluded_hypotheses: attention V or attention output projection as the cause of this MLP-only comparison

required_tests: observer construction does not mutate dense weights
temporary projected evaluation restores every dense weight exactly
projection updates are finite and use the registered refresh cadence
training config validation rejects compact-parent, resume, compile, or missing-identity misuse

decision_rule.dense_replay_mismatch: Invalidate the causal comparison and repair determinism; do not interpret the shadow.
decision_rule.shadow_terminal_gap_at_most_0p05: Classify COMPACT_GRADIENT_PATH_DRIFT. Next design must preserve a dense-equivalent functional gradient path without retaining dense inference weights; do not tune code assignments first.
decision_rule.shadow_terminal_gap_above_0p05: Classify LOCAL_ASSIGNMENT_HYSTERESIS because the fresh-fit capacity oracle already passes. Next test must replace local warm-start assignment with a compact global/coarse-to-fine reassignment mechanism before any new LM endpoint.

operations.preflight: Foreground-poll the exact config through the standard empirical-GEMM MFU gate; require at least 20 percent MFU.
operations.scientific_run: Expected above five minutes. Use one idempotent terminal/error-only watchdog whose callback explicitly asks @Codex to seal and continue; no 20/50/80 callback for this sub-two-hour run.
operations.storage: No checkpoint or trajectory tensor snapshots; retain the compact JSON replay result, log, status, provenance, MFU certificate, and hashes only.
